ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. Which response best shows understanding of Types of verses? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of verses.
   B. Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Types of verses has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Types of verses to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Administration of Zakat? (1 mark)
   A. Use Administration of Zakat to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Types of Divorce? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of Divorce.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

11. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn? (1 mark)
